findings.text: follow-on: in inspect_shot the level-1 store is opened with zarr.open_group(str(path), mode='r') outside the try/except that captures array_metadata errors into row['errors']; an unreadable or corrupt shot store therefore raises out of the ThreadPoolExecutor and aborts the whole cohort pass, and the summary's inventory_errors guard cannot see it because the exception never becomes a recorded error. Impact: one bad store among 577 destroys the run's evidence instead of being counted; the design already distinguishes absent/unreadable, so the open belongs inside the guarded block.

justifications.durability: The refusal machinery is genuine and I falsified it in a scratch copy of the two files: widening RELATIVE_TOLERANCE to 1.0e9 turns test_scaled_current_fails_tolerance and test_upper_quantile_and_missing_shots_prevent_promotion red (2 failed, 16 passed, EXIT=1, review-mutation-tolerance.log), so the tolerance and coverage guards are live rather than vacuous. The named check is exercised in the positive direction too: data-pass.log records the control refusal actually firing under main() at EXIT=1. The detail receipt is written before the known-channel control is checked, so a refused measurement keeps its evidence. Gap: inspect_shot opens the level-1 store with zarr.open_group outside the try/except that feeds row['errors'], so an unreadable store aborts the whole cohort pass instead of being counted in inventory_errors; no production consumer imports the new module.
justifications.evidence: Reproduced independently at the reviewed head in its own worktree (read-only, --basetemp /tmp/review-tf-head): tests/test_mast_tf_average.py is 18 passed, EXIT=0, module and cwd both under the reviewed tree (review-head-gate.log). The unresolved verdict is backed by a real cohort pass: data-pass-inline.log (job 1282011, revision 1227e204) inventories 577/577 shots with finite amc/tf_current, 564 finite efm/bvac_r*efm/bvac_val products, level2_present_shots 0, inventory_errors 0, scored_shots 0, verdict unresolved. The instrument is shown to see known-present data before the absence is reported: the control shot 30420 finds 24 level-1 toroidal paths via the same array_metadata reader, and the first data attempt (job 1282010, data-pass.log) failed the level-2 control at EXIT=1 and is retained. The census is pinned by sha256 in the receipt. Gaps: the receipt embeds revision 1227e204 (the code commit) while reviewed_head_sha d95f9296 is a docs-only commit (2 insertions); the 8.7 MB detail inventory is cited by path+sha but lives outside git under the run directory.
justifications.fit: The node follows repository shape: a new benchmarks/ module beside its tests/ file, argparse entry point, numpy-only, typed signatures, mechanism-stating docstrings. No plan, sprint or version label and no author attribution appears in the new source or the fragment (grep-clean on the head blobs). The evidence fragment is a single project-absolute link to the committed receipt, matching the fragment convention, and the receipt is committed (163125 bytes, under the 300000-byte bound enforced in main).
justifications.goal_fidelity: plan s6 asks that the toroidal field be validated in two layers never fitted together: first the axisymmetric average against the measured R*Bphi with a tolerance stated before scoring, then the ripple and n>=1 error-field against the n-resolving set, each promoted, bounded or recorded as unresolved. This node owns the first layer: benchmarks/mast_tf_average.py:38 pins RELATIVE_TOLERANCE = 2e-2 before any shot is read, cohort_shots (line 116) reclassifies the pinned census with the production owner calibration_experiments and selects ExperimentClass.TOROIDAL_FIELD_ONLY (577 shots). The measured R*Bphi is not produced: aggregate_comparisons (line 82) returns verdict 'unresolved' with scored_shots 0 because no admissible independent absolute measurement is established, and the receipt's observable.used is null. Recording the average as unresolved is an explicitly permitted s6 outcome, and 'Do not absorb plasma response or a passive mismatch into a TF geometry correction' is honoured (nominal.fitted_corrections is []). Gap: the second layer (ripple / n>=1 error-field vs the s5 n-resolving set on held-out vacuum shots) and the s6 ablation are not attempted by this node; s6 as written is not closed here.
justifications.reuse: The change reuses the existing classification, error-field and cohort machinery rather than reimplementing it: cohort_shots calls nova.imas.mast_calibration_cohort.calibration_experiments with ShotSurvey (filtered to dataclass fields) and ExperimentClass.TOROIDAL_FIELD_ONLY; inspect_shot imports DRIVEN_CURRENT, ERROR_FIELD_CHANNELS and ERROR_FIELD_ALIASES from nova.imas.mast_error_field_screen and KILO, SHOT_STORE, ShotSurvey from nova.imas.mast_vacuum_cohort. No thresholds or cohort logic are duplicated, and MU_OVER_TWO_PI reuses the physical constant rather than a raw literal.
justifications.scope_discipline: The whole diff between base 646b68b8 and head d95f9296 is four paths, all inside the reviewed manifest's declared write paths: benchmarks/mast_tf_average.py, tests/test_mast_tf_average.py, docs/evidence/fragments/mast-nonaxisymmetric-physics/mast-tf-average.html and docs/figures/mast-tf-average/receipt.json; no out-of-scope file is touched. The declared write paths also name docs/figures/mast-nonaxisymmetric-physics/ (unused); nothing else in the declaration is over-reached.
